# Dalmatian Fire Safety

> Fire risk assessments for residential and low-risk commercial buildings across London, carried out by Raphael Whitmore, a TIFSM-accredited fire risk assessor.

Dalmatian Fire Safety provides Type 1 and Type 3 residential fire risk assessments (BS 9792:2025) and low-risk commercial fire risk assessments (PAS 79-1:2020) across London, including for HMOs, managing agents, freeholders, and small business owners. Assessments are carried out to satisfy the legal duty under the Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005.

## Pages

- [Services](https://dalmatianfiresafety.co.uk/services.html): What's covered in a fire risk assessment, assessment types, and pricing.
- [About](https://dalmatianfiresafety.co.uk/about.html): Background and accreditations of the assessor, Raphael Whitmore (TIFSM).
- [Articles](https://dalmatianfiresafety.co.uk/articles.html): Plain-English guidance on fire safety rules and requirements for landlords, managing agents, and business owners.
- [Contact](https://dalmatianfiresafety.co.uk/contact.html): Enquiry form and contact details.
